name: airllm
description: AirLLM 2.8T LLM inference with single 4GB GPU
one_liner: A trick that lets a cheap, small graphics card run gigantic AI models that normally need an expensive data-center computer.
buyer: A small AI startup or researcher who wants to experiment with huge open-source language models without renting expensive cloud GPU time.
business_use_cases: A startup prototypes with a massive open-source model on a single affordable GPU before committing to expensive cloud inference costs.
A university research lab runs large models for experiments on existing modest hardware instead of requesting a costly GPU grant.
An indie AI developer offers a 'try the biggest open models on your own laptop' tutorial/service for hobbyists priced out of cloud AI.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed, pay-per-run hosted inference service that uses this technique to undercut standard cloud GPU pricing.
Sell a paid setup/consulting package helping teams configure big-model inference on their existing low-end hardware.

steal_this: Spin up a tiny hosted API this weekend that runs a popular giant open model cheaply via this technique, and charge per request, undercutting mainstream inference providers.
